name: meta_shops-mcp
description: Facebook & Instagram Shops (ecommerce channels): me, update_listing, set_inventory, end_listing, lis

platform_mcp_meta_shops_access_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_META_SHOPS_ACCESS_TOKEN
platform_mcp_meta_shops_access_token.description: System-user (or long-lived user) access token of a Meta app with catalog_management and, for orders, commerce_account_manage_orders / commerce_account_read_orders permissions on the commerce account; sent as Authorization: Bearer.

platform_mcp_meta_shops_catalog_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_META_SHOPS_CATALOG_ID
platform_mcp_meta_shops_catalog_id.description: Product catalog id (Commerce Manager > Catalog > Settings).

platform_mcp_meta_shops_cms_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_META_SHOPS_CMS_ID
platform_mcp_meta_shops_cms_id.description: Commerce account (CMS) id; required for list_orders.

platform_mcp_meta_shops_currency.title: PLATFORM_MCP_META_SHOPS_CURRENCY
platform_mcp_meta_shops_currency.description: ISO currency of the catalog prices, e.g. USD; required when update_listing sends a price ('9.99 USD').

tools.name: me
tools.description: Reads the configured product catalog {id, name, product_count} to verify the token and catalog access.

tools.name: update_listing
tools.description: items_batch UPDATE for one PRODUCT_ITEM: `listing_id` is the item's retailer id (data.id); price is sent as '<amount> <currency>' using the currency config field; quantity maps to quantity_to_sell_on_facebook. Changes go LIVE on Facebook/Instagram shops once processed; raw.handles[0] is the batch handle and raw.validation_status lists per-item errors.

tools.name: set_inventory
tools.description: items_batch UPDATE {id: sku, quantity_to_sell_on_facebook}: `sku` is the retailer id of the catalog item (required).

tools.name: end_listing
tools.description: items_batch DELETE removes the item (retailer id = listing_id) from the catalog and therefore from Shops and catalog ads; not reversible (re-create it to restore).

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: GET /{cms_id}/commerce_orders?state (FB_PROCESSING|CREATED|IN_PROGRESS|COMPLETED, comma-separated; default CREATED). `since` is not applied because updated_after is a Unix timestamp. Pagination is by Graph cursors (raw paging), so only the first page is returned; amounts are in raw.estimated_payment_details. New orders must be acknowledged (POST /{order_id}/acknowledge_order) before fulfilment; not done here.

tools.name: mark_shipped
tools.description: Attach Shipment POST /{order-id}/shipments {idempotency_key, tracking_info: {carrier, tracking_number}}; items are omitted, so 'all unfulfilled quantities of items on the order' are shipped. When sending tracking_info both carrier and tracking_number are required.
